answers.core: As far as I know, this is impossible to implement as an add-on. It *might* be possible in a C++ module as long as you don't care about messages before you apply the hooks, but I do - intrinsically, if you want to record messages before you apply a callback, you need engine support for that.
answers.workaround: No; there's currently no way to retrieve log messages from in-game without engine modifications.
